chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Dawud al-Ijli, from Zurara, from Humran, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

When God, Blessed and Exalted, created the creation, He created sweet water and salty bitter water. The two waters blended; then He took clay from the surface of the earth and kneaded it with an intense kneading. He then said to the companions of the right — who were like crawling particles — [proceed] to Paradise in peace; and said to the companions of the left: to the Fire, and I care not.
Then He said [7:172]: 'Am I not your Lord?' They said: 'Yes, we testify' — lest you should say on the Day of Resurrection: We were heedless of this.

Then He took the covenant upon the Prophets, saying: Am I not your Lord? And that this is Muhammad, My messenger, and that this is Ali, the Commander of the Faithful? They said: Yes! So prophethood was confirmed for them. And He took the covenant upon the Determined Ones (Ulu al-'Azm): I am your Lord, and Muhammad is My messenger, and Ali is the Commander of the Faithful, and his successors after him are the guardians of My command and treasurers of My knowledge — peace be upon them — and that through al-Mahdi I shall grant victory to My religion, and through him I shall manifest My governance, and through him I shall exact revenge from My enemies, and through him I shall be worshipped willingly and unwillingly.

They said: We acknowledge, O Lord, and we testify. And Adam neither denied nor acknowledged. Thus the determination was confirmed for these five regarding al-Mahdi, and Adam did not become one of the Determined Ones in acknowledging him — and this is His word, Mighty and Majestic [20:115]: And We had given a covenant to Adam before, but he forgot; and We found no firm resolve in him. He [the Imam] said: Rather, he [Adam] was left out.

Then He commanded a fire and it was kindled. He said to the companions of the left: Enter into it; but they feared it. And He said to the companions of the right: Enter into it; so they entered it and it was cold and safe upon them. Then the companions of the left said: O Lord, forgive us! He said: I forgive you — go and enter. But they feared it. Thus, obedience, wilayah, and disobedience became established.

key_terms.أَصْحَابُ الشِّمَالِ: Companions of the Left — those destined for the Fire, whose nature was formed from salty water
key_terms.أَصْحَابُ الْيَمِينِ: Companions of the Right — those destined for Paradise, whose nature was formed from sweet water
key_terms.أُولُو الْعَزْمِ: The Determined Ones — the five greatest Prophets (Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa, Muhammad) who fully affirmed the covenant
key_terms.الْمِيثَاق: The primordial Covenant — the pre-existential agreement taken from souls before creation
key_terms.الْوَلَايَة: Wilayah — the divinely appointed guardianship and loyalty to the Imams

ai.seo_question: What does al-Kafi say about the primordial covenant and the creation of souls?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) narrates a primordial cosmological account of creation, describing how God mixed the waters and kneaded the clay before separating humanity into the companions of the right and left. He then recounts the successive covenants (mithaq) taken from all humanity, the Prophets, and finally the Prophets of Determination (Ulu al-'Azm), in which acknowledging the imamate of Ali and the eventual victory of al-Mahdi was a condition. The hadith concludes by explaining Adam's exclusion from the Prophets of Determination due to his hesitation, and dramatizes how obedience and wilayah were established through the trial of fire — which burned the disobedient but was cool and safe for the obedient.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Dawood Al Ijaly, from Zurara, from Humran, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High Created the creation, Created the sweet water and salty bitter water.

So He<sup>azwj</sup> Blended the two waters, and Grabbed clay from the crust of the earth and Kneaded it with an intense Kneading. So He<sup>azwj</sup> Said to the companions of the right, and they were like the crawling particles: “To the Paradise in peace!”, and Said to the companions of the left: “To the Fire, and I<sup>azwj</sup> don’t Care”.
Then Heazwj Said [7:172] Am I not your Lord? They said: Yes! We testify. Lest you should say on the Day of Judgement: Surely we were heedless of this.

Then Heazwj Took the Covenant upon the Prophetsas, so Heazwj Said [7:172] Am I not your Lord? And that this is Muhammadsaww, Myazwj Rasoolsaww, and that this is Aliasws Amir Al-Momineenasws?’ They said: Yes! We testify. So the Prophet-hood was Affirmed for themas. And Heazwj Took the Covenant upon the Determined Ones (Ul Al-Azam) (from the Prophetsas): “Iazwj am youras Lordazwj, and that this Muhammadsaww is Myazwj Rasoolsaww, and Aliasws is Amir Al-Momineenasws and the successorsasws from after himsaww are the Masters of Myazwj Command and Treasurers of Myazwj Knowledge, and that Al-Mahdiasws, Iazwj Shall Grant victory to Myazwj Religion through himasws, and Manifest Myazwj Government through himasws, and Exact revenge from Myazwj enemies through himasws, and Iazwj shall be worshipped willingly and unwillingly through himasws”.

Theyas said: ‘Weasws acknowledge, O Lordazwj, and we testify’. And Adamas neither denied nor acknowledged. Thus, the Determination was affirmed for these five regarding Al-Mahdiasws, and Adamas did not become a Determined One (Ul Al-Azam) upon the acknowledgement of himasws, and these are the Words of the Mighty and Majestic [20:115] And We had Given a Covenant to Adam before, but he forgot; and We did not find determination in him’. Heasws said: ‘But rather, heas was left out.

Then Heazwj Commanded the Fire, so it inflamed, and Heazwj Said to the companions of the left: “Enter into it”, But they were terrified of it. And Heazwj Said to the companions of the right: “Enter into it”. So they entered into it, and it was cold and safe upon them. So the comanions of the left said, ‘O Lordazwj! Forgive us’. So Heazwj Said: “Iazwj Forgive you, so enter into it”. But, they were terrified of it. Thus, with this obedience, the Wilayah, and the disobedience (to Wilayah) came to take place’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Dawud al-’Ijli from Zurara from Humran from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far (a.s.) has said, ‘As Allah, the Most Holy the Most High, created the creation.

He created sweet water and a very salty water and then mixed the two together. Then He took a (kind of) clay from the surface of the earth and kneaded it intensely. He then said to the people of the right, as they crawled about like particles, “To paradise (you go) in peace.” He then said to the people of the left hand, “To the fire (you go) and I am not concerned.”

Then He asked, “Am I not your Lord?” They all said, “Yes, You are our Lord we testify.” Allah said, “I make you to witness this) so that on the Day of Judgment you will not say, ‘We were unaware of this.’” [7:172] ‘Then He made the prophets to form the covenant.

He asked them, “Am 1 not your Lord and is not this Muhammad, My messenger and is not this Ali, the commander of the believers?” They said, “Yes, it is just as You said.” This established their prophethood. He then made the ‘Ulu al-’Azm messengers to testify and acknowledge this fact: “I am your Lord, Muhammad is My messenger, Ali is the commander of the believers and his successors, recipients of divine supreme covenant, after him are people who possess My Authority and are the reservoir of My knowledge. That al-Mahdi (a.s.) is one whom I will make to lend support to My religion. Through him I will establish My kingdom on earth and make My enemies to face justice for their crimes. Through him I will make them to worship Me willingly or otherwise.” The prophets altogether said, “Yes, Lord we testify to these facts and bear witness.”

Adam did not refuse and did not affirm (verbally) the fact about al-Mahdi (a.s.) so he was not included in the group of five ‘Ulu al-’Azm messengers of Allah. Adam did not have the resolve to affirm the facts about al-Mahdi, recipient of divine supreme covenant. Allah, the Majestic, the Glorious, has said in the Holy Quran, “We had made a covenant with Adam before but he forgot all about it and we did not find in him a firm resolve.” [20:115] He said that it was so but he ignored it.

He then created a fire that blazed and told the people of the left hand to enter in the fire. They were afraid thereby. He said to the people of the right hand, “Enter in the fire.” They entered in the fire and it was cool and peaceful to them. The people of the left hand then said, “Lord, forgive us and reduce our sins.” The Lord said, “I have forgiven you but you must go in the fire.” They were afraid. Thus, with this the obedience, authority and disobedience came to take place.’”
